items = [
        ("tent", 10, 120),
        ("stove", 3, 65),
        ("lantern", 2, 45),
        ("rope", 3, 20),
        ("camera", 5, 90),
        ("blanket", 5, 85),
        ("water", 6, 100),
    ]
    capacity = 20
    table = zeros(Int, length(items)+1, capacity+1)
    for i in eachindex(items), weight = 0:capacity
        item_weight, item_value = items[i][2], items[i][3]
        table[i+1, weight+1] = table[i, weight+1]
        if item_weight <= weight
            table[i+1, weight+1] =
                max(table[i+1, weight+1], table[i, weight-item_weight+1]+item_value)
        end
    end
    chosen = falses(length(items))
    remaining = capacity
    for i = length(items):-1:1
        if table[i+1, remaining+1] != table[i, remaining+1]
            chosen[i] = true
            remaining -= items[i][2]
        end
    end
    println("items: ", join((items[i][1] for i in eachindex(items) if chosen[i]), " "))
